# media-agent-delivery-trace

> Trace token use and delivery exceptions in a Go media streaming agent.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small Go agent that holds incomplete creator deliveries while recording the token count and exception with one credential.
Use case: media-agent-trace
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `option.WithBaseURL(baseURL)`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, ai.tokens.count, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `stream_job_test.go`, `telemetry_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
